title: 3D Billiards Pro
description: Step up to a crisp 3D emerald felt pool table with realistic ball physics, dotted bank-shot guidelines, smooth power-cue control, and classic 8-ball table runs.
controls: Drag around the table to line up your cue aiming guideline, then pull back and release the power bar to strike the cue ball.

zh-CN.title: 3D 台球精英
zh-CN.description: 真实物理碰撞 3D 桌球竞技：清晰辅助瞄准线 + 丝滑蓄力推杆手感，精准走位连杆清台体验一杆进洞快感！
zh-CN.controls: 拖动桌面调整球杆瞄准角度，下拉左侧力度条蓄力后松手击球进袋。
